title: Run command (agent)
description: Runs a program on the agent host. Never runs through a shell: argv[0] is the absolute path of the executable.

argv.title: Command
argv.description: Executable and arguments. The first entry must be an absolute path.

oncePerHost.title: Run once per host
oncePerHost.description: Run once per host when several certificates deploy together; the script must not rely on per-certificate variables.
